items.title: RT by @charliebilello: RT by @charliebilello: The Fed cut rates by 50 bps in September 2024, declaring victory against inflation. That was a policy mistake, and they compounded the mistake by cutting another 125 bps. They should hike rates by 50 bps this month and follow that up with 50 bps hikes in October and December.
items.content:
The Fed cut rates by 50 bps in September 2024, declaring victory against inflation.

That was a policy mistake, and they compounded the mistake by cutting another 125 bps.

They should hike rates by 50 bps this month and follow that up with 50 bps hikes in October and December.
— Charlie Bilello (@charliebilello) Sep 1, 2026
